In cima alla seduta: Sandisk (SNDK, +11,90%); KLA Corporation (KLAC, +7,32%); Marvell Technology (MRVL, +7,05%). In fondo: Lululemon Athletica (LULU, -17,38%); Fair Isaac (FICO, -16,68%); Autodesk (ADSK, -8,26%).

en: US markets were closed on Saturday, September 5, 2026, so there is no new session to report: the last one, September 4, 2026, was covered in the previous edition and its numbers are not repeated here. This edition reads instead the 121 stories published since then by 15 outlets we track, and brings forward the 24 that matter most.

Leading the weekend coverage: CNBC reports: “Sugar is outperforming the stock market this year. Here's what's driving it, and where it can go from here”; CNBC reports: “Iran warns of ‘more painful’ response to U.S. attacks as economic pressure mounts”; CNBC reports: “AI data centers are transforming rural land markets — and fueling a backlash”.
By theme: Markets and macro (82), Crypto (14), Tech (10), Italy (9).
What did trade while the exchanges were shut, measured from Friday's US close: Solana +3.92%; Ethereum +1.14%. These are the only market moves in this edition — they are quotes, not forecasts.
it: I mercati americani erano chiusi sabato 5 settembre 2026: non c'e' una seduta nuova da raccontare — l'ultima, 4 settembre 2026, e' gia' stata coperta dall'edizione precedente e i suoi numeri qui non vengono ripetuti. Questa edizione legge invece le 121 notizie uscite da allora su 15 testate seguite, e porta in primo piano le 24 piu' rilevanti.

In evidenza nel fine settimana: CNBC riporta: «Sugar is outperforming the stock market this year. Here's what's driving it, and where it can go from here»; CNBC riporta: «Iran warns of ‘more painful’ response to U.S. attacks as economic pressure mounts»; CNBC riporta: «AI data centers are transforming rural land markets — and fueling a backlash».
Per tema: Mercati e macro (82), Crypto (14), Tech (10), Italia (9).
Cosa ha scambiato a borse chiuse, misurato dalla chiusura americana di venerdi': Solana +3,92%; Ethereum +1,14%. Sono gli unici movimenti di mercato di questa edizione: quotazioni, non previsioni.

headline.en: Markets closed: Saturday's news in brief, with Solana +3.92% since Friday's close
headline.it: Mercati chiusi: le notizie di sabato in sintesi, con Solana +3,92% dalla chiusura di venerdi'
